HERO.SUB: A digital innovation pipeline that connects student work at An‑Najah Innovation Park with industry challenges, AI matchmaking, and incubation — turning final‑year ideas into real products.

PIPELINE.LEAD: Most universities stop at the graduation exhibition. innoPark turns that one moment into a six‑step ignition path — from submission through to market deployment.
PIPELINE.S1_D: Teams publish their graduation project with a structured profile.
PIPELINE.S2_D: Faculty supervisors and reviewers grade and tag for readiness.
PIPELINE.S3_D: Projects are paired with industry challenges by skill and intent.
PIPELINE.S4_D: Promising teams enter the Innovation Park's structured program.
PIPELINE.S5_D: Companies sign formal collaboration on solutions and pilots.
PIPELINE.S6_D: Ventures launch — measured by revenue, hires, and impact.

MATCHER.LEAD: Our matching engine reads project skills, technologies, and intent against open industry briefs — and surfaces the strongest fits with transparent reasoning.
MATCHER.PROJ_DESC: Senior CS team at An‑Najah using satellite imagery + ML to forecast yield across West Bank groves.
MATCHER.COMP_DESC: Looking for a data team to forecast olive‑grove output across the 2026 harvest cycle.

PROGRAMS.LEAD: innoPark is built around four interlocking products — a virtual booth, live industry briefs, an AI matcher, and a structured incubation pipeline.
PROGRAMS.P1_DESC: 240+ graduation projects in a structured, searchable digital exhibition — open year‑round.
PROGRAMS.P2_DESC: Live problem statements from 67 partners — from agritech yield models to clinic workflow.
PROGRAMS.P3_DESC: Skill, intent, and tech‑stack pairing between teams and challenges — with transparent scoring.
PROGRAMS.P4_DESC: Six‑step path from submission through to market deployment, with mentors at every stage.

NEWS.LEAD: Updates from An‑Najah Innovation Park — platform milestones, new features, and how the pipeline is bridging university talent with industry demand.
NEWS.N1_TITLE: innoPark goes live at An‑Najah Innovation Park
NEWS.N1_EXCERPT: The platform is now open to final‑year students, faculty supervisors, and industry partners — bringing An‑Najah graduation projects into a structured digital showcase for the first time.
NEWS.N2_TITLE: Try the AI Matcher instantly — no account needed
NEWS.N2_EXCERPT: Any company or partner can now submit an industry challenge and receive AI‑ranked project matches in seconds. No registration required — just describe your problem and see the best‑fit teams.
NEWS.N3_TITLE: Six stages from booth to market: inside the pipeline
NEWS.N3_EXCERPT: From structured submission and faculty evaluation to AI matching, incubation, and formal industry partnership — here is how innoPark turns final‑year projects into market‑ready ventures.

CTA.SUB: Whether you have a project to launch or a challenge to solve, innoPark is the meeting point.
